title: Flaky: testjig chat_client_wire message_query_descending_returns_newest_first
description: Batch 17 CI (HEAD 553ea5df): crate-jmap-testjig/tests/chat_client_wire.rs:812 failed once under full-workspace stable load (first two ids swapped), passed 5/5 isolated reruns, full stable rerun and beta. The test separates three sends by a 2 ms tokio sleep (lines 805-808), so two messages can get equal sentAt. Find the root cause: either the test relies on timing the spec does not guarantee (then give the messages distinct sentAt deterministically, e.g. explicit timestamps, without weakening the newest-first assertion), or the server/backend ordering for equal sort keys is nondeterministic where it should be stable (then fix the implementation). Never weaken, skip or delete the assertion.
